_comment: The long bow (the owner, 2026-11-27; docs/gameplay/26): press anywhere and hold, and the aim line grows from the hero's bow hand to the red target (Lv 5: 50 % of the way a second), stopping at its distance; let go: the arrow flies to the line's tip, the rings round the target set its damage. Held 2.5 s with no drag: it lands near the middle.
